lines: A solo world class now starts in its world: press Start riding, and the world fades in around the class.
With no bike, the world keeps loading, and the card says to wake the bike and connect it before you ride.
Once the world is ready and the bike connected, Start riding turns on and takes focus.
The renderer that built and warmed the world carries on in the class ride, so nothing is built twice.
The class video plays in the corner with its own sound; without it, the world's own track plays.
The class in its world, from a phone to the full screen.
What the tests prove: the bike gates the start, one renderer, a fade, and the world's music.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
